subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: When a plan is generated from a locked feature draft, the system shall require the plan to pass the rules the plan projection enforces.
rationale: No plan reaches projection unless it passes the projection's rules; the plan follows the lock (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-25)
fit_criterion: A plan that breaks one projection rule — a dependency cycle, an oversize task without an accepted size, a trace to a nonexistent requirement — is refused naming the rule; a valid plan passes.
